newsitem.title: USA: Krantor says in Empire Kosher settlement.
newsitem.headline: Krantor says in Empire Kosher settlement.

text.p: Krantor Corp said on Monday that it and Empire Kosher Poultry Inc, and Affiliated Island Grocers Inc have reached a settlement of all claims pending between the companies in the United States District Court for the Middle District of Pennsylvania and in the Superior Court of New Jersey.
Reached for comment, Krantor chief financial officer Mair Faibisch said that Empire had sued Krantor and Krantor's Affiliated Island affiliate for delivery of goods, and that Krantor had countersued.
He said the one of the terms of the settlement was that terms could not be revealed. "We are not unhappy with the settlement but we can not release the terms," he said.
Krantor Corp is engaged in the food brokerage business, specializing in the distribution of frozen seafood and brand name grocery products to major wholesalers and retailers in the United States.
Empire could not immediately be reached for comment.
